Inner_Packet_Field_Dependent_Mutations.Description: Sets EDIV to 0x0000 and RAND to 0x0000000000000000, which is an invalid combination as both fields should not be zero simultaneously for security reasons.
Sets EDIV to 0xFFFF and RAND to 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF, which tests the maximum boundary values of these fields.
Sets LEN field in BTLE_DATA PDU to a value that exceeds the practical limit, causing an inconsistency with the payload size.
Sets SN to 1 (Odd) and NESN to 0 (Expecting retransmission or new data), which creates an inconsistent sequence expectation.
